=== HYPOTHESIS ===
# p_d1e6 — Baking household: the kitchen counter is a bakery twice a week

Both Marco and Yuki bake regularly. Marco bakes on weekday mornings (06:30–09:00) and weekend mornings (08:00–11:00). Yuki bakes on weekend afternoons (13:00–16:00). During baking, the baking tray, mixing bowl, cutting board, spatula, and kitchen knife are all on the counter. The oven (not a receptacle, but the counter area) is occupied. The shopping bag appears at the pantry after grocery runs on Saturday mornings. This hypothesis predicts the counter is heavily occupied 06:30–09:00 on weekdays and 13:00–16:00 on weekends.

What sets this hypothesis apart: the baking_tray_shared and mixing_bowl_shared are at counter_k1 (not pantry_shelf_k1) during baking windows. If the robot finds them at pantry_shelf_k1 at 07:30 on a weekday or at 14:00 on a Saturday, this document is refuted. The spatula and kitchen_knife are also at counter_k1 during these windows rather than in the drawer.
